facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on LA-7201 and ZV-7210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2017 a potential incident was recorded on LA-7201 and ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
